reviewTitle: Earbuds lost internal sync and wouldn’t reconnect.
reviewDescription: Quit syncing with each other after just 6 months. Happened in the middle of a workout session too, so it was very weird. I have done every step of trouble shooting possible with these, including in the manual and the online instructions for factory reset. Their own website is almost useless, considering the fact it was asking me to press buttons that didn’t exist for my model number. For just a little over 6 months, that’s terrible quality, and it seems to be a common problem with this brand. Giving 2 stars purely for the fact that WHEN they DID work, they were absolutely great for the price range. But I’ve bought other ones at the same price range that lasted years.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on June 9, 2026
